attributes.action: Reduce the Under-16s ban to under-13s
attributes.additional_details: Im making this petiton to reduce the under 16 ban cus i believe a ban for people who are 13-16 is to harsh and can effect online friendship messaging Ur family not being able to watch Ur fav creators  and with a under 16 ban some of the older mature people who know how to balance between life and social will have nothing to do and doing the same things will get boring at one point so I think reducing the ban will help a Alot of teens in the United Kingdom.
